criteria.title: Target vehicle-computer identity
criteria.passCondition: Hardware model, CPU architecture, RAM, storage, OS image, kernel/runtime and display class are recorded in the evidence package.

criteria.title: Software and dependency identity
criteria.passCondition: Git commit, product version, package lock digest, SBOM and build provenance resolve to the tested installation.

criteria.title: Firmware, configuration and calibration identity
criteria.passCondition: Signed firmware manifest/revision, configuration revision and sensor calibration revision are recorded and compatible with the tested software build.

criteria.title: Power-cycle and boot-to-ready
criteria.passCondition: Cold/warm power cycles complete without unsafe state and target-hardware boot-to-usable-driver-surface measurements are recorded with an approved project-specific threshold.

criteria.title: HMI performance under representative load
criteria.passCondition: Target display records frame-time/jank under map, surround and warning load, and demonstrates deterministic fallback after renderer loss.

criteria.title: Long-duration resource soak
criteria.passCondition: Target hardware completes an approved multi-hour soak with bounded RSS/heap, event-loop health and no unbounded safety-state growth.

criteria.title: Fault injection and degraded modes
criteria.passCondition: Sensor loss/staleness, reconnect, provider loss, storage/evidence degradation, WebGL loss and restart scenarios fail safely and preserve warning-only authority.

criteria.title: Update rollback and recovery
criteria.passCondition: Signed update rejection, incompatible release rejection, failed-install recovery and rollback are exercised against the target release chain.

criteria.title: Controlled closed-track execution
criteria.passCondition: Approved scenarios are executed in a controlled closed-track environment with test operator, vehicle, route, weather, sensor state and result evidence recorded.

criteria.title: Independent acceptance review
criteria.passCondition: Safety/cyber/engineering reviewers approve the evidence package for the defined closed-track scope only. Public-road and homologation approval remain separate decisions.
